ObjectRef.description: object_id belongs to registered owner: canonical projected primary key or common instance id; never coerced between owners. Exact revision is separate.

AuthorizedObjectView.description: snapshot_revision is random server-stored opaque projection handle, bound to Account, context, permitted fields and exact snapshot; not a global counter or permission token.

PublicOutcome.description: Only public action result. Internal owner results never serialize directly. AuthorizedScreen contains only independently permitted objects, fields, and actions; command status requires original-principal receipt visibility. No global totals or hidden head tokens.

$comment: Schemas describe strictly decoded internal typed values. CCF1 command/journal wire encodes every integer as a canonical decimal string, rejects JSON numeric values and duplicate/unknown fields, sorts ASCII object keys, preserves text without NFC/NFKC normalization. Numeric bounds apply after exact integer decoding. Existing18/19/24 codecs retain their explicitly distinct formats. These are design schemas, not generated OpenAPI or executed codecs.
